title: Slider Ready Extent Indicator
description: UI sliders can show preloaded content (e.g. puzzle 3d fill slider is dynamically extended). Instead of adjusting the range as content becomes ready, keep min/max fixed and show a highlighted line to the right of the knob until the ready extent. Wire through WindowMeasure::Slider.ready and the React Slider (and wgpu slider render path). Update puzzle 3d fill-count measure to use fixed max FILL_COUNT_MAX and ready=available_count.
summary: Follow-up: ready preload segment now uses accent-secondary (highlighted) instead of emphasized. Fill slider label stays fixed; WindowMeasure::Slider.loading drives the measure tree-leaf loading ring while planning continues.
